scripts.dev: npm run build -w @timmy/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @timmy/contracts" "npm run dev -w @timmy/api" "npm run dev -w @timmy/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @timmy/contracts && npm run dev -w @timmy/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @timmy/contracts && npm run dev -w @timmy/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @timmy/contracts && npm run build -w @timmy/web && npm run build -w @timmy/api
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && npm run deploy:staging -w @timmy/api
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && npm run deploy:production -w @timmy/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @timmy/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @timmy/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @timmy/api && npm run typecheck -w @timmy/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @timmy/contracts && npm run test -w @timmy/contracts && npm run test -w @timmy/api && npm run test -w @timmy/web
scripts.test:watch: npm run build -w @timmy/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts-build,contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @timmy/contracts" "npm run test:watch -w @timmy/contracts" "npm run test:watch -w @timmy/api" "npm run test:watch -w @timmy/web"
